## Runs 6 / 7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0: electron n_cal = +3.2×10¹², hole n_cal = −1.2×10¹²

Raw first (Rxx = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6)), then the B-space poly5 background, FFT in 1/B, and `sdh_onset`. Both records are clean: T 1.17–1.29 K, gate currents ≤ 0.22 nA, no rail (R max 0.53–0.59 kΩ of the 5 kΩ full scale).

**Electron (run 6).** Above ~4 T the device is in the QH regime: Rxx minima at 4.29 / 4.98 / 6.00 T fall at ν_cal = 30.8 / 26.6 / 22.1. Read as the 4-fold ladder ν = 28 / 24 / 20, they give **density scale S = n_true/n_cal = 0.906** (spread 0.903–0.908). This is a model-independent lever-arm check, −9 % against the geometry prior, inside its 10–15 % band. So **F_L,true = 30.0 T** at this spot. FFT tones (B ≥ 1 T):
- **≈ 30 T**, strongest in the high-B windows, onset 1.76 T.
- **22.2 T**, onset 1.40 T.
- **14.8 T**.
- **7.3 T**, censored at the 1 T edge and flagged near-residual.

Two readings sit on this spectrum, and neither is dropped yet:
- *Harmonic screen:* 14.8 ≈ 2 × 7.3, and 22.3 ≈ 3 × 7.3 (ratio 3.05).
- *Luttinger-aware:* 7.3 + 22.3 = 29.6 T ≈ F_L,true. The model ABAB pair at n_true = 2.9 is 6.3 / 23.6 T.

The 30 T tone sits at F_L,true, which has three candidate origins: an ABCA singleton, an ABAB breakdown sum, or the total-filling QH ladder (present whatever the FS count). **One density cannot decide between them; the n-dependence does.** A harmonic tracks 3 × f exactly, while a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (at n_cal = 2.0 the model puts 3 × light at 8.9 T but heavy at 15.8 T). On top of that come the F_L-tone origin tests (B-window split, LK).

**Hole (run 7).** F_L,cal = 12.4 T. Tones: 6.6 T (onset 0.71 T), 12.3 T, 4.7 T, 8.5 T, plus 9.4 / 14.8 T at 2 × and 3 × 4.7 T. This is the near-CNP exception regime (model ABAB pair close and balanced, 5.3 / 7.1 T; ABCA m* ≈ 1 mₑ, so LK-dead), and at low |n| the offset uncertainty dominates. **It is a preview, not a decisive read.**

**What the fan inherits.**
- **Cleaner side: electron.** It is the only side that reaches the design density |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² at D = 0; the hole side is TG-capped at −1.27×10¹².
- **Onset: 1.00 T.** This is `sdh_onset` on the 10 mT section. It is censored, so the true onset is ≤ 1 T. Run 6's 50 mT grid below 1 T was under Nyquist for F_L, so the sub-1 T onset was not measured.
- **Sampling:** 10 mT at 1 T, i.e. Δ(1/B) = 0.010 = 1/(3·F_L,cal).
- **Sensitivity and settling:** sr1 at 50 µV, τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct.

**Carried confound:** region B (run 5), a parallel ridge at +0.43×10¹² relative to region A, sits in series between B_1 and B_2. Expect possible extra tones at about ×1.13.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (electron, n_cal = +3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n_cal = -1.2e12), D = 0.
Raw first (Rxx vs B), then B-space poly5 background removal, FFT in 1/B (sdh_fft) vs F_L,
per-tone onsets (sdh_onset), and the QH-minimum density-scale anchor on the electron record."""
import warnings
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, resolve_channels

H_E = cst.h / cst.e
SPOTS = {6: 3.2, 7: -1.2}          # n_cal, 1e12 cm^-2 (run-5 calibration)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 11))
for j, (rid, n_cal) in enumerate(SPOTS.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n_cal * 1e16))
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n_cal = {n_cal:+.2f}e12, F_L(cal) = {FL:.2f} T, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T, {len(B)} pts, "
          f"R(B0) {R[0]:.0f} Ohm, R max {R.max():.0f} Ohm @ {B[R.argmax()]:.2f} T (FS 5 kOhm), T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K, "
          f"|I_tg|,|I_bg| max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f}, {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    # onset on the adequately sampled record only (run 6 below 1 T was a 50 mT grid: under Nyquist for F_L there)
    b_lo = 1.0 if rid == 6 else 0.3
    m = B >= b_lo - 1e-6
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], b_lo=b_lo, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 1e-8)
            print(on.summary())
        except SdhOnsetError as e:
            print("SdhOnsetError:", e)
        for ww in w:
            print("  warn:", ww.message)
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.8)
    ax[0, j].set(title=f"run {rid} raw Rxx (B_1-B_2), n_cal = {n_cal:+.1f}e12, D = 0", xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)")
    mb = B > 1.0
    dR = R[mb] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[mb], R[mb], 5), B[mb])
    ax[1, j].plot(1 / B[mb], dR, lw=0.7)
    ax[1, j].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel="dRxx (Ohm), poly5-in-B removed, B > 1 T")
    for lo in (1.0, 1.4, 2.0):
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, B.max()), bg_degree=5, log=False, nfft=4096)
        S = S[0]; sel = (f > 2) & (f < 1.6 * FL)
        ii, _ = find_peaks(S[sel], prominence=0.08 * S[sel].max())
        top = sorted(zip(S[sel][ii], f[sel][ii]), reverse=True)[:5]
        print(f"  FFT [{lo}, {B.max():.0f}] T: " + ", ".join(f"{fp:.1f} T ({sp/top[0][0]:.2f})" for sp, fp in top))
        ax[2, j].plot(f, S / S[sel].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"B >= {lo} T")
    ax[2, j].axvline(FL, c="k", ls="--", label="F_L (cal)")
    if rid == 6:
        ax[2, j].axvline(0.906 * FL, c="r", ls=":", label="F_L x 0.906 (QH scale)")
    ax[2, j].set(xlim=(0, 1.6 * FL), ylim=(0, 1.2), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT |.| (norm)"); ax[2, j].legend(fontsize=7)
    if rid == 6:   # QH minima -> density scale (model-independent: B_nu = n h / (nu e))
        mq = B > 4
        ii, _ = find_peaks(-R[mq], prominence=40)
        Bm = B[mq][ii]; nu_cal = n_cal * 1e16 * H_E / Bm
        print("  QH Rxx minima B = " + ", ".join(f"{b:.2f}" for b in Bm) + " T -> nu_cal = " + ", ".join(f"{v:.1f}" for v in nu_cal))
        nu_int = [28, 24, 20, 16]; S_qh = np.array(nu_int) / nu_cal[:4]
        print(f"  assign nu = {nu_int} (4-fold steps): S = n_true/n_cal = {S_qh.round(3).tolist()}; "
              f"nu = 28/24/20 mean {S_qh[:3].mean():.3f} (nu = 16 sits on the flank of the 8.8 T peak, shifted low)"
              f" -> F_L,true = {S_qh[:3].mean()*FL:.1f} T")
fig.suptitle("sdh-spot-check runs 6 (electron) / 7 (hole), D = 0, T = 1.17-1.29 K"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — per-column SdH FFT for the stacking call

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n\_cal +1.50..+3.20e12 (35, dn 0.05) x B 1.0->6.0 T uniform-1/B (85 rows, d(1/B) 0.0099), fast 2.4 s / slow 3 s, sr1 50 uV; ends at 6 T, gates parked · **ETA ~08:36** (≈3h10m)

The spot checks (runs 6 / 7, ana cells 14–15) favour the **electron side**. It is the only side that reaches the design density at D = 0. At n_cal = +3.2 its record carries 7.3 / 22.3 / ≈30 T tones, with F_L,true = 30.0 T from the QH-minimum scale (S = 0.906). One density cannot say whether 22.3 T is a real heavy pocket, as in an ABAB pair (7.3 + 22.3 ≈ F_L,true), or 3 × 7.3 T, or whether the 30 T tone is a singleton. **The fan answers that from each tone's n-dependence** (investigation Step 4/5).

**Design, lever by lever (landau-fan step 1):**
- **B_lo = 1.0 T.** This is the `sdh_onset` value on run 6's 10 mT record. It is censored, so the true onset is ≤ 1 T.
- **n window: n_cal +1.50 → +3.20×10¹².**
  - The top column **repeats the run-6 spot on a different grid** (uniform-1/B vs uniform-B). That is the free grid-change / alias check.
  - Over the window the model ABAB heavy/F_L runs 0.885 → 0.79, while ABCA stays at 1.0. The model also puts 3 × light at 4.9 → 19 T, well apart from heavy at 12.4 → 23.6 T.
  - Below 1.5 the ABAB heavy tone approaches F_L (the exception regime), so it cannot discriminate.
- **N_n = 35 (δn = 0.05).** The LL ray spacing at 1 T is 0.107×10¹² in cal units, so this gives ≥ 2 samples per ray period.
- **B_hi = 6 T.** δF = 1/(1/B_lo − 1/B_hi) = 1.2 T. At n_hi the heavy tone is ~6 T from F_L,true (≫ 2δF). Going to 10 T only adds QH-regime rows and 29 min of traverse (δF 1.11 T).
- **B axis: uniform in 1/B, 85 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.0099 = 1/(3·F_L,cal(n_hi)).** At the low edge that is the spot check's 10 mT. With 3 samples per period, the 2nd-harmonic alias of the ≈30 T tone lands at ≈41 T, outside the band. Any in-band harmonic alias shows up by its reversed n-slope.
- **Dwell: fast_delay 2.4 s = 8τ** (τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct; the rig floor is 7–10τ). slow_delay is 3 s = 10τ after the flyback.
- **Sensitivity: sr1 50 µV (5 kΩ FS).** R(B = 0) along the line is 58–84 Ω (run 5) and run 6 reaches ≤ 125 Ω for B ≤ 6 T, so the low-n × 6 T corner has > 10× headroom. Auto-guards: leak > 1 nA, T > 2 K, or ≥ 10 railed points interrupts the cell.

**Coverage trade, stated:**
- **Hole side excluded.** At D = 0 it is TG-capped at −1.27×10¹², inside the near-CNP exception regime, and run 7 is a preview only.
- **Light partner, ≥ 5 periods:** resolvable only for n_cal ≳ 3.0 (f ≳ 6 T in [1, 6] T).
- **Below 1.5:** the n-range down there carries mainly the heavy-tone position, the partition via F_L, and the per-column QH ladder (scale pin).
- **Price of more light-tone reach:** extending B_lo to 0.8 T is +25 rows (≈ +55 min), and it needs a measured sub-1 T onset first.
- **Carried confound:** region B (+0.43×10¹², series) may add tones at ×1.13.

**Checkpoints:**
- **First row** (1.0 T, ~9 min in): R 50–90 Ω, no rail, I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at the pA floor, T at base. Abort there on any failure.
- **Row ≈ 50** (B ≈ 2.0 T, ~1h35m): partial per-column FFT on [1, 2] T. The question is whether the ~22 T tone tracks its own Onsager curve or 3 × light across n. Continue unless the columns are flat or railed.
- **Row ≈ 70** (≈ 3.1 T, ~2h20m): same read, sharper.

**End state:** gates parked at 0 and the **field left at 6 T**. The LK mass-split series (Verify, `temperature-dependence-vti`) rides down from there; no re-traverse.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n_cal +1.50 -> +3.20e12 (35) x B 1.0 -> 6.0 T uniform-1/B (85) ===
# Per-column SdH-FFT fan for tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4. Grid inherits the run-6 spot check
# (Delta(1/B) = 0.0099 = 1/(3 F_L,cal) at n_hi; sr1 50 uV; tau 0.3 s / 24 dB). Magnet ascends from where it sits.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration (run 5; ratio data-calibrated, scale geometry prior; runs 6 QH minima say n_true ~ 0.906 n_cal) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
ns = np.round(np.arange(1.50, 3.2001, 0.05), 4)            # 35 pts, dn = 0.05e12 (>= 2 per LL ray period at 1 T)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 1.0, 6.0, 85
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)                         # ascending, uniform in 1/B
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and np.abs(B_vec).max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.4, 3.0                           # 8 tau at 24 dB/oct (floor 7-10 tau); 10 tau after flyback
SENS = 50e-6                                                 # 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA — inherited from runs 6/7
I_TRIP, RAIL_FRAC, RAIL_MAX, T_MAX = 1e-9, 0.95, 10, 2.0
print(f"n_cal {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(ns)}), D = {D0}; Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; "
      f"roundtrip end n,D = {calc_nD(Vtgs[-1], Vbgs[-1], CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")
print(f"B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B) = {abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)).mean():.5f} 1/T, dB {np.diff(B_vec)[0]*1e3:.0f} -> {np.diff(B_vec)[-1]*1e3:.0f} mT")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_tau, _slope, _amp = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope(), sr1.amplitude()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv:.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05; ramps to {B_LO} T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), "
      f"PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"sr1 tau {_tau} s / {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24), drive {_amp} V (1.0 -> 10 nA), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at ~0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01 and heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24, "lock-in settling changed — FAST_DELAY priced on tau 0.3 s / 24 dB"
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 1e-6, "drive amplitude changed — sensitivity sized on 10 nA"

sr1.sensitivity(SENS)
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n_cal {ns[0]:+.2f}->{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 (35), B {B_LO}->{B_HI} T uniform-1/B (85), "
                  f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV; cal run 5; stacking FS-count Step 4")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (cal run 5: ratio 0.773, n_offset -0.089, D_offset -0.013; '
              f'QH scale n_true/n_cal ~ 0.906 from run 6), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform in 1/B, {N_B} rows x {len(ns)} pts, '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB; investigation tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4')

# --- position: gates to the first column, magnet 0 -> B_LO (blocking ramp ~7 min) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_LO)
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_rails = []
def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, T, x1 = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4]), abs(float(data[9]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f}, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if T > T_MAX:
        print(f"T TRIP: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_MAX} K at B={float(data[1]):.3f}")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
